heroHeadline: AfD Hits Record 28% as Germany Drives NATO's Ukraine Financing Push and EU-US Trade Deal Seals Auto Reprieve
heroSubtitle: A Forsa poll on May 19 showed AfD at a record 28% — its widest lead over CDU/CSU (22%) ever recorded — as the governing coalition's July reform roadmap faces deep skepticism. Germany's Foreign Minister Wadephul traveled to the NATO Helsingborg ministerial (May 21-22) and formally proposed a €40B multilateral NATO Ukraine financing mechanism ahead of the Ankara Summit. The EU-US trade deal implemented on May 20 averted the threatened 25% US tariffs on German cars, delivering a key win for Merz's economic agenda. On the security front, police arrested five far-right teenagers linked to the 'Last Defense Wave' terror network — accused of arson attacks in Brandenburg and Thuringia.
